comment: An identification number generated for each person for Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) use only. EDW Person ID is used as the key for all references to persons in the EDW.

The date the details for the job detail history record became effective in the corresponding source system.
For records no longer in effect, this is the day before the record expired in the EDW (i.e., the last effective date). For current records, expiration date is set to 12/31/9999.

When the value is 'Y', this indicates the record is considered to contain current, effective information when associated with the payroll job earnings. The value of 'N' indicates that the record is no longer considered to contain current information.

When the value is 'Y', this indicates the record is considered to contain current, effective information. The value of 'N' indicates that the record is no longer considered to contain current information. The value of 'D' indicates that the record has been deleted from the source system.
The status code indicates whether an employee is active, terminated or on leave, with or without benefits.
The job title.
The employee class is a high level grouping of employees and details that are associated with this grouping. Details from the employee class default to the position class unless otherwise changed.
The full description or title for the associated Employee Class.

Table divides the salary groups into smaller groups that are related. For instance you might have one for each union.

Each salary table must have at least one grade to be usable and there is no maximum. Each Group/Table/Grade combination created indicates whether it is hourly or salaried, as well as the low, minimum, and high salary, and rate.

Salary Steps are tied to a grade and are not required. In general these are used with the type of union or other job where the schedule dictates an automatic increase to another higher step after a certain period of longevity.
The full time equivalency percentage assigned to this job.
The number of hours an employee filling this job normally works in a day.
The number of hours an employee filling this job normally works in a pay period.
The regular hourly rate for this job. If this field is entered or defaulted from the Salary/Rate Rule Form, the Assign Salary is system calculated.
The salary to be paid each pay period. If the Assignment Salary is entered, the Annual Salary is calculated based on the factor and vice versa.
The number of pays per calendar year.
The annual salary for the job based on the calendar year. If the Annual Salary is entered, the Assignment Salary is system calculated based the factor and vice versa.
A code which contains the reason an employee changed jobs.
A description of the reason an employee changed jobs.

Date the change became effective, regardless of payroll.
Job contract number.
Indicates the time entry method. Valid values include 'TimeSheet', 'Exception Time Only' or 'None'.
A code indicating the type of premium pay associated with the job.
A description of the code indicating the type of premium pay associated with the job.
Indicates whether the job is temporary and paid only once or whether it is a permanent job.
Date when the record was inserted or last modified in the EDW.
Indicates whether a staff member is affliated with the University.
This field is used to determine actual FTE worked (Job FTE * Appointment Percent).
A description that categorizes the status of records as current, no longer effective (i.e., expired), effective in the future or deleted for University Business.
The Data Expiration Date (DED) is the implied end date of a particular record. The DED Creates an effective data range for a particular record when used with the Effective Date.
Indicates whether this job is an Open Range, Established, Prevailing, or Negotiated job.
An indicator (Y/N) that indicates if the change in the job record was due to the Salary Planner upload
A code identifying which types of leave an employee in this job is eligible for.
A full description or title of the leave category code for which an employee in this job is eligible.
A description for the code identifying the organization associated with the job detail record.
The EEO Skill Code identifies the expertise that a particular job needs. Valid values include 12 - Execute/Admin and Managerial, 22 - Faculty, 23 - Other Academics, etc.
The EEO Skill Description decodes the EEO Skill Code. Valid values include 12 - Execute/Admin and Managerial, 22 - Faculty, 23 - Other Academics, etc.

The EEO Job Group Title is a decode of the P-Class Code. Valid values include B = Athletics/Recreation, C = Business and Finance, D = Communications/Public Relations/Advancement, E = Community/Human Services, etc.
Identifies how time is entered for each job. Valid values for this column are: P = Payroll, W = Web, D = Departmental, T = Third Party
A description of Time Entry Method Code.

A code which identifies a Position Class which can then be assigned to a Position. Example valid values are NAAAA = DIR, NFPCA = DIR ASST RSSPT PJCOR, etc
The employee class is a high level grouping of employees and details that are associated with this grouping. Details from the employee class default to the position class unless otherwise changed.
A Y/N Flag that identifies if a job is a Civil Service position (Y) or not (N). It uses the Job E-Class Code to identify Civil Service Positions.
For the Position Number - Job Suffix combination, this is the Supervisor's EDW Pers ID.
For the Position Number - Job Suffix combination, this is the Supervisor's Position Number.
For the Position Number - Job Suffix combination, this is the Supervisor's Job Suffix.
The two digit Job Detail Admin Code identifies the Vice Chancellor that a person would report to.
The Job Detail Admin Name is the title associated with the Job Detail Admin Code.
The Employee Group Code is the first character of the employee Class Code. For example, A - Faculty, B - Academic Professional, C - Civil Service, etc.
The employee group description is the decode of the employee group code. For example, A - Faculty, B - Academic Professional, C - Civil Service, etc.
The user ID of the person or process which updated the job detail record.
The HRFE transaction number which updated the job detail record.
The HRFE component number which updated the job detail record.
Code that identifies an employee's remote working status - valid values are 1 - 5.
Description tied to the code identifying an employee's remote working status. Examples of valid values are No Remote (1), All Remote Out of State (3), Hybrid in State (4), etc.
Indicates the leave report method code attached to the job. Valid values are P (None), W (Leave Report on the Web), D (Departmental Leave Report), T (Third Party Leave Report).
Indicates the leave report method description attached to the job. Valid values are None, Leave Report on the Web, Departmental Leave Report, Third Party Leave Report.
